The ''' father''' of [[Durrei]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]. Durrei's [[Parent/Legends|father]] lived on [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]. He and his [[Durrei's mother|wife]] were [[Death/Legends|murdered]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] shortly after [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].<ref name="Relic" />
